Sandbox_KIPN_MaintenanceFrequency_toolti: How often KIPN runs its automatic housekeeping sweep (expired sessions, stale player statistics, orphaned claims). A sweep always runs about 2 minutes after server start regardless of this setting; this controls the repeat interval. A sweep on a tidy server is a few quick table scans that write nothing, so more frequent is not meaningfully more expensive -- the interval mainly decides how promptly reclaimed save space and orphaned-claim grace clocks are acted on. Every 15 minutes: space is reclaimed almost immediately, at the cost of a little extra log noise. Every hour (default): a good balance for most servers. Every 6 hours: minimal log noise; trimmed data may linger a few hours longer before removal. Only at server startup: the sweep runs once per boot and never again while running -- best for servers that restart daily; on a server that stays up for weeks, stale data accumulates between restarts.

Sandbox_KIPN_DiagnosticJsonExportEnabled: When enabled, KIPN periodically writes a full human-readable snapshot of its database to Zomboid/Lua/kipn_data.json for bug reports. This is never read back and is not authoritative (the save's ModData is). Disable to remove the periodic write entirely.

Sandbox_KIPN_PlayerStatsRetentionDays_to: KIPN periodically drops stored statistics for players not seen for this many real-time days, to bound save growth on long-lived servers. A returning player simply starts fresh statistics. Set to 0 to keep every player's statistics forever.

Sandbox_KIPN_OrphanClaimGraceDays_toolti: When a claim's owning service module (e.g. a companion mod) is no longer installed, KIPN flags the claim and, if the module is still missing after this many real-time days, purges it. Set to 0 to purge orphaned claims as soon as they are detected (not recommended -- a mod that fails to load once will lose its claims).
